en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahi, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having been asked

about the Fasting woman cooking in the pot, so she tastes the stock awaiting over it. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem’. He (the narrator) said, ‘And he<sup>asws</sup> was asked about the woman who happens to have the child for her, and she is Fasting, so she chews the bread and feeds it to him. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem, and the bird, if there was one for her’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about the case of a fasting woman who tastes to examine the salt of a cooking pot. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful.’” He (the narrator) has said that he asked him (the Imam) about a fasting woman who has a child and she chews the bread to feed him. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful. So also is the case of a bird that belongs to her.’”
